scripts.build: node -e "console.log('BUILD_START', Date.now())" && astro build && node -e "console.log('BUILD_END', Date.now())"
scripts.check:heap: node -e "const v8=require('v8'); console.log('execArgv', process.execArgv); console.log('NODE_OPTIONS', process.env.NODE_OPTIONS||''); console.log('heap limit', v8.getHeapStatistics().heap_size_limit/1024/1024,'MB');"
